image_text_dominance.value: image 65 / text 35, image on the left

unexpressed: shallow focus: sharp foreground, blurred backdrop (m4). The model's own fragile_if_changed names this as the defining feature, and no shell parameter can carry it

light from one side only (sealed feature; model only implied it via m4's highlight location)
diagonal recession to the upper left (m5)
foreground out-of-focus occluder bottom-right (m6): verify on the overlay before trusting

image_text_dominance.value: field 40 / figure 60, display type cropped by the frame edge

four letters stacked vertically along the left edge (m6)
white shapes sitting exactly on the yellow/black seam (m5, h4)
